description: ReEDS: Electricity demand profiles 2022 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Caitlin Murphy, Trieu Mai (Carnegie Institution of Washington). This record provides hourly modeled state-level electricity demand profiles for the contiguous United States (U.S.), produced by Evolved Energy Research (EER) using the EnergyPathways model and used in the Regional Energy Deployment System (ReEDS) model. Additional details are provided in the ReEDS documentation. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 3 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
